## Import Legacy Data (IL)

A CSV FILE in the realm (`source` link or `sourceUrl`, a CsvFileDef — the export dropped into the workspace, kept as provenance and re-runnable; `csvText` is the paste fallback) → Case records: each row minted a Record Identifier in import order and an External Reference back to its legacy id. PER-ROW RESULTS: an unreadable date or a status outside the realm's own vocabulary FAILS AND SAYS WHY — never coerced, never skipped. Dates are calendar days (utils/csv.parseCsvDate): nothing shifts a day east of UTC.

### Non-goals

No live sync, no column auto-mapping guesswork — the expected header is documented and enforced.

### Guards

Refuses an invalid id pattern before the first write; refuses a file whose header lacks subject/status/opened/legacy_id. The desk's Setup step lists only importable files by querying `CsvFileDef.columns`.

### How the desk feeds it

Setup step 5 has an **Upload CSV** button: the chosen file is written into the realm under `imports/` (WriteTextFileCommand, non-conflicting name), appears in the picker (a flat `type + eq columns` search — an `every` wrapper breaks the host's htmlQuery binding), is pre-selected, and Import rows runs the command with `sourceUrl`. Paste stays as the no-file fallback.

The command reads a CSV file or pasted text rather than a card, so this Spec has no linked example.

cardInfo.name: Import Legacy Data
cardInfo.summary: Legacy CSV → records, per-row results, calendar-day-safe dates.

attributes.cardDescription: Turns a legacy CSV export into Case records with new ids, keeping the legacy id as provenance.
